dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.content: 早速ですが、はじめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If it's alright with you, shall we get started?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: あなた様の年齢と性別を教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: 30歳、女です。
dialogue.English: I'm 30 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 本日は、どのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, how can I help you today?

dialogue.content: はい、夫は外国人なんですけど、自分の意見が絶対な人で、更にコロナでイライラしてて、私もビクビクしながら育児をしてて、しんどいです。
dialogue.English: Well, my husband is a foreigner, and he's the type of person who thinks his opinion is absolute. He's been even more irritable because of COVID, and I feel like I'm walking on eggshells while raising our child. It's just exhausting.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。しんどい思いをされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you're going through a very difficult time.

dialogue.content: 詳しく教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.content: はい。しかも、今はお互い在宅勤務だし。夫は家事や育児にもうるさくて、気を遣います。音に敏感で皿洗いも音を立てないように。夫が大事にしているさらも割ったら大変。朝の家事のバタバタの時に子供にDVDを見せていたら、朝からそんなのダメだとか。職場では違う様ですが、私のすることなすこと否定されます。
dialogue.English: Yes. On top of that, we're both working from home now. He's very critical about housework and childcare, so I’m constantly on edge. He’s sensitive to noise, so I have to wash the dishes without making a sound. It would be a disaster if I broke one of his precious plates. If I put on a DVD for our child during the busy morning routine, he says that’s no good first thing in the morning. Apparently he’s different at work, but at home he criticizes everything I do.

dialogue.content: 夫婦揃って在宅勤務ですか。いろいろとストレスが溜まりますよね。あなた様は、仕事しながら家事や育児もして大変ながらもこなしているのがすごいです。しかし、旦那さんに否定されるのは辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: So you're both working from home. That must be very stressful. It's amazing that you're managing to handle your job, housework, and childcare, even though it's so demanding. But it must be painful to be criticized by your husband like that.

dialogue.content: はい、ずっと怒られてばかりで、気が気じゃないです。
dialogue.English: Yes, he’s always scolding me, and I’m constantly on edge.

dialogue.content: しかも、
dialogue.English: What's more,

dialogue.content: 国に帰ったら再入国できないとかで、囚われの身だとか、私を日本代表みたいにイライラをぶつけてきます。
dialogue.English: he says he can't re-enter the country if he goes back home, so he feels like a prisoner, and he takes out his frustration on me as if I'm the representative for all of Japan.

dialogue.content: ずっと怒られていると、しんどい気持ちになりますよね。また、いろいろなイライラをぶつけてくるのですね。
dialogue.English: Being constantly scolded must make you feel really worn out. And he's venting various frustrations on you.

dialogue.content: そのような言葉を言われるとつらいですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be very painful to hear those kinds of things.

dialogue.content: そうですね。私が悪くないことまで。家族は一緒にいるものだっていう考えが強くて、休日もずっと一緒を強いられて休む暇がありません。
dialogue.English: It is. Even for things that aren't my fault. He has this strong belief that families must always be together, so he forces us to be together all the time on his days off, and I never get a break.

dialogue.content: そうですか。ゆっくりする時間がないのですね。ゆっくり休める時間が欲しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. You don't have time to relax. You'd like some time to rest peacefully, right?

dialogue.content: 在宅勤務は、いつごろから始まったのですか？
dialogue.English: When did you start working from home?

dialogue.content: ええ。そんなことが続いてるからかどうかわかりませんが、子供が吃り始めて。バイリンガルなんですけど、英語も日本語もひどくて、夫が「あわてず、ゆっくり、いってごらん」とか子供に話してて。夫は天才肌で自分の中の定義が絶対で、調べたりしようとせずに、押し付けてきます。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm not sure if it's because of all this, but my child started stuttering. Our child is bilingual, but the stutter is bad in both English and Japanese. My husband tells our child things like, 'Don't rush, speak slowly.' My husband thinks he's a genius and that his own definitions are absolute, so he just forces his ideas on us without ever looking anything up.

dialogue.content: 言語聴覚士さんに聞いたら、夫の様な対応は良くないそうです。
dialogue.English: I asked a speech-language pathologist, and they said my husband's approach is not good.

dialogue.content: 行き違ってすみません。
dialogue.English: My apologies for the confusion.

dialogue.content: 在宅勤務は、4月半ばからです。
dialogue.English: We've been working from home since mid-April.

dialogue.content: 大事な子供のことを心配になりますよね。言語聴覚士さんに、相談したのですか？
dialogue.English: It's natural to be worried about your precious child. Did you consult with a speech-language pathologist?

dialogue.content: 在宅勤務は4月からはじまったのですね。
dialogue.English: So, you started working from home in April.

dialogue.content: そうですね。夫には言語聴覚士さんという頭はなくて、私が調べて予約しました。
dialogue.English: That's right. The idea of a speech-language pathologist never even occurred to my husband. I was the one who researched it and made the appointment.

dialogue.content: また、夫は
dialogue.English: Also, my husband...

dialogue.content: 子供に関わる人でも、英語が出来ない人を見下します。言語聴覚士さんのところへは私だけで行きましたが、英語が分かる人でないのでよく思ってません。私も、喧嘩とか言い合いは、そこまで英語ができません。
dialogue.English: ...he looks down on anyone involved with our child who can't speak English. I went to the speech-language pathologist by myself, but he doesn't approve of them because they don't understand English. And my English isn't good enough for arguments or heated discussions.

dialogue.content: 夫にはもう育児の相談はしたくないんです。
dialogue.English: I don’t want to discuss parenting with my husband anymore.

dialogue.content: そうですか。そのような態度をとられるのですか。育児について、相談したくなるのも当然だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's his attitude. It's completely natural to want to talk to someone about parenting.

dialogue.content: 育児について相談できる人はいるのですか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone you can talk to about parenting?

dialogue.content: それがいないですね。ご夫婦で話し合ってるカップルが羨ましくも感じますが、うちはもう無理です。
dialogue.English: Unfortunately, no. I envy couples who can talk things through together, but for us, that feels impossible now.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。うらやましく感じますね。話し合いもできない感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. It’s understandable to feel envious. Does it feel like you can’t even have a discussion?

dialogue.content: 受け入れない感じですね。ただ、私が言語聴覚士さんのところに子供と通うようになってからは、吃音のことに関しては口出ししてこなくなりました。他のことは、相変わらずあーだこーだと私のことは否定されますけどね。
dialogue.English: He doesn’t seem open to it. However, since I started taking our child to the SLP, he’s stopped interfering when it comes to the stuttering. With other things, though, he still goes on and on, criticizing everything I do.

dialogue.content: 内心、どう思ってるかは知りませんけど…。
dialogue.English: I don’t know what he’s really thinking inside, though...

dialogue.content: 吃音のことだけは、私の思うように動けてます。
dialogue.English: At least when it comes to the stuttering, I'm able to do what I think is best.

dialogue.content: 話し合いを受け入れてくれないのですか。吃音に関しては、口をだすことはなくなったのですね。他のことに言われるのは、つらいですね。
dialogue.English: So he won't accept a discussion. But he has stopped commenting on the stuttering. It must be painful to be criticized about everything else.

dialogue.content: 吃音に関しては、誰かに相談されたのですか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the stuttering, have you consulted with anyone?

dialogue.content: 言語聴覚士さんだけです。今後は、英語のことや、ハーフの子育てに関しては指南してくれる人が欲しいです。夫が見下さないような、英語も出来る人が良いです。なかなかみつからないです。
dialogue.English: Only the speech-language pathologist. In the future, I'd like to find someone who can guide me on matters related to English and raising a biracial child. It would have to be someone who can speak English, so my husband won't look down on them. It’s hard to find someone like that.

dialogue.content: 私は、夫から否定される度に言い返せなかったので、そのうち何も言えなくなってしまいました。
dialogue.English: Every time my husband criticized me, I couldn't talk back, and eventually, I just stopped saying anything at all.

dialogue.content: そだったのですね。子育てに関しては、心配になりますよね。みつかったら、とても安心してますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's natural to be worried about raising your child. It would be a great relief if you could find someone, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですね。私のブレーンみたいな人がいたら、夫にも言い返してやりたいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it would be. If I had someone like an advisor on my side, I'd want to be able to talk back to my husband.

dialogue.content: 旦那さんから、言われる続けるとそうなると気持ちがしんどくなりますよね。言い返したくなるのも当然だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: When you’re constantly being criticized by your husband, it wears you down. It’s only natural to want to push back.

dialogue.content: 今までの話を聴いて、今回は、旦那さんとの関係についてなのか子供の子育てどちらで悩んでいますか？また、どちらに焦点を当てたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: From what I’ve heard so far, are you mainly struggling with your relationship with your husband, or with how to raise your child? Which would you like us to focus on?

dialogue.content: 私はいつしか言い返すことを忘れてしまったんですけど、言語聴覚士さんのところへ行ってから、夫の根拠のない持論にも立ち向かえる様になりました。吃音についてはどうにかなったか出来たけど、他はどうしていったらいいのか分かりません。
dialogue.English: At some point I had forgotten how to speak up for myself, but after going to the SLP, I became able to stand up to my husband's baseless theories. I managed to do something about the stuttering, but I don't know what to do about everything else.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですか。前に進むことができたのですね。それは、本当によかったです。
dialogue.English: I see. So you were able to take a step forward. That's really wonderful.

dialogue.content: 吃音についてはどうにかなったけど、他はどうしていったらいいのかわからない状態ですね。
dialogue.English: So you've managed to deal with the stuttering, but you're not sure how to handle the other issues.

dialogue.content: でも、吃音以外はどうしよう。
dialogue.English: But what about everything else besides the stuttering?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: それは、旦那さんの行動でよろしいかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you referring to your husband's behavior, is that correct?

dialogue.content: すみません、一つ読み落としてました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I missed one of your messages.

dialogue.content: 子育てを巡る夫との関係ってかんじです。
dialogue.English: It’s about my relationship with my husband when it comes to parenting.

dialogue.content: なるほど。わかりました。だいぶ、整理がつきました。
dialogue.English: I see. That clears things up quite a bit.

dialogue.content: あなた様は、子育てをどうされたいのか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me how you would like to approach parenting?

dialogue.content: 私の相談に乗ってもらえて、色々と教えてくれる人が欲しいです。それを、子供にしてあげめ、夫にケチつけられたら、理論立てて夫に説明したいです。
dialogue.English: I want someone who can listen to my concerns and give me advice. I want to apply that for my child, and if my husband finds fault with it, I want to be able to explain it to him logically.

dialogue.content: あげめ → あげて
dialogue.English: Correction: 'あげめ' -> 'あげて'.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。あなた様の相談や話を旦那様に聴いてもらいたいですよね。大事な子供のためにも。
dialogue.English: I understand. You want your husband to listen to your concerns and ideas, for the sake of your precious child as well.

dialogue.content: 一方的に押し付けないで欲しいです。勝手な思い込みは特に…。
dialogue.English: I don't want him to just force his opinions on me. Especially his arbitrary assumptions...

dialogue.content: 勝手な思い込みは、周りが振り回されますよね。
dialogue.English: Arbitrary assumptions can really throw everyone around you for a loop, can't they?

dialogue.content: お話の途中ですが、そろそろお時間ですが、どうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I know we're in the middle of our conversation, but our time is almost up. How are you feeling about our session today?

dialogue.content: そうですね。私のことだけならまだしも、子育てに関して間違ったことを押し付けて欲しくないっていうのを再認識出来ました。
dialogue.English: Well, I was able to reconfirm that, while it's one thing if it's just about me, I don't want him forcing incorrect ideas on us when it comes to parenting.

dialogue.content: 言語聴覚士さんのところへ行ってから、夫の根拠のない持論にも立ち向かえる様になったことは大きな一歩だと感じます。大事な子供の子育てを大切にし、旦那様の押し付けが少しでも減るように期待してます。
dialogue.English: I feel that being able to stand up to your husband's baseless theories after visiting the speech-language pathologist is a huge step forward. I hope you can continue to prioritize your child’s well-being and that your husband’s imposing behavior lessens, even a little.

dialogue.content: また、機会があればぜひお話を聞かせてください。
dialogue.English: If you have the chance, please feel free to talk with me again.

dialogue.content: 本日は、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 有り難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイを終了します。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This concludes the role-play. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 有り難うございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
